metadataRaw.title: Lower Back Pain? Do THIS for 30 Seconds
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to help quickly relieve lower back pain, even in as little as 30 seconds!

These exercises focus on stretching and strengthening the main muscles that can contribute to lower back pain, helping provide both quick and long-lasting relief.

They can be done at home with no special equipment and are shown in different positions, making it easy to find what works best for you.

For the best results, go through them all and use the exercises that give you the most relief.

Watch now and start relieving lower back pain in seconds!

0:00 Intro
0:27 Seated Exercise
2:36 Standing Exercise
5:09 Bed/Floor Exercise
7:26 Decompression Exercise
10:01 Strengthening Exercise
